verdict.rationale: The evidence shows many core workflows are available programmatically. Inference runs through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, models deploy via CLI (`truss push` / `baseten model push`), training steps are API calls (Loops), usage can be queried by API key or model, and an official MCP server lets agents manage the workspace. Nothing states that the API matches everything the UI can do, and the OpenAPI probe found no published management API spec. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, documented management REST API (e.g. OpenAPI spec) covering workspace/billing/deployment administration, independent corroboration of parity.
